title: The morning after
logline: Monday. The morning after the dock. Coffee at the island's one café. The line. The dialect of the place — 'oat milk?' — and Wood's answer. The strip is still on the island for three more days and already leaving.

panels.composition: An island café, white, morning. A line of linen. WOOD at the counter in the chore coat, the suit gone back to its hanger.

balloons.text: Regular's a whole order where I'm from.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a bright white island café with a line of guests in linen and a thin man in a canvas chore coat at the counter

panels.composition: The cup. A leaf drawn in the foam. Wood looking at the leaf like it's a strip somebody else drew.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, close-up of a coffee with a leaf drawn in its foam and a thin man's skeptical eyes above it

panels.composition: Wood at a window table. The sketchbook open. The page: last night's dock — the two of them, from the shore, her head on his shoulder. Drawn from memory this morning. One panel of it.
props: the sketchbook: the dock, two figures

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a thin man at a café window drawing in a sketchbook a small scene of two figures on a dock at night seen from the shore, one head resting on the other's shoulder
image.notes: The Sunday's panel 5, redrawn from memory the morning after, in the sketchbook. The strip shows it once, small.

panels.composition: Wood closing the book on it. The coffee. The leaf gone. The window: the ferry, far off, coming.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a thin man closing a sketchbook at a café window with a ferry visible far off through the glass, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: 'Regular's a whole order where I'm from.' The dock, redrawn from memory, closed on.
